sites.name: Sand Bar Flat Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $25 per night Double Site: $50 per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: Developed campground on the Middle Fork of the Stanislaus River, great fly fishing and secluded camping. Please practice Leave No Trace and Pack it in, Pack it out principles.
sites.directions: 10 miles north of Highway 108 at Spring Gap turnoff (Fraser Flat Road Forest Road 4N01), Right on Forest Road 4N88, left on 4N85
sites.restrictions: Max length for RV/Trailers - 35ft. Road is NOT ADVISABLE for large RVs and trailers. The winding road is steep, narrow and is not paved past Fraser Flat Campground. Camp in designated sites only. The number of people permitted in a single campsite is six. The maximum length of stay in any…
sites.reservations: First come, first serve. No reservations can be made for Sand Bar Flat Campground.

sites.name: Hull Creek Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $25 per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: Developed campground with OHV opportunities and camping spots, access OHV trails from the campground. Please practice Leave No Trace and Pack it in, Pack it out principles.
sites.directions: 12 miles southeast of Long Barn on 3N01.
sites.restrictions: Camp in designated sites only. The number of people permitted in a single campsite is six. The maximum length of stay in any campground is 14 days. Two vehicle limit per site.
sites.reservations: First come, first serve. No reservations can be made for Hull Creek Campground.

sites.name: Fraser Flat Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $28 per night Double Site: $56 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $10 per vehicle per night Day Use: $5 per vehicle per day
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Forested site on the South Fork Stanislaus River. Two sites, a vault toilet, and two fishing piers are accessible. Please practice Leave No Trace and Pack it in, Pack it out principles.
sites.directions: 3 miles north of Highway 108 at Spring Gap turnoff (Fraser Flat Road).
sites.restrictions: Camp in designated sites only. The number of people allowed in a single campsite is six. The maximum length of stay in any campground is 14 days.
sites.reservations: First come, first serve. No reservations can be made for Fraser Flat Campground.
